verdict.rationale: Docs confirm phone integration via SIP trunking, letting agents receive calls routed from existing PBX/phone systems, and agents can be created/managed via the API — but there is no explicit evidence of provisioning new phone numbers or of initiating outbound calls through the API, only inbound call routing on existing infrastructure. missing for 10: explicit phone number provisioning endpoint, explicit outbound-call API/trigger capability, and any hands-on confirmation of full inbound/outbound API call flow.
